summary.text: Linda Harriott-Gathright is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 10 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She sits on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee, according to Ballotpedia's committee listings for the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Linda Harriott-Gathright ran unsuccessfully for a New Hampshire House seat from Hillsborough 26 in 2010 and won a seat from Hillsborough 36 in 2012, serving there from 2012 to 2014.
She returned to the House in 2018 and has represented Hillsborough 10 since the 2022 election, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee in the 2013-2014, 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
